thread:
maria_pm: Quick check — we need a final consensus on the MVP cutboard. Enterprise pilot wants tenant SSO + audit logs which pushes scope. Can we decide by EOD? T-3w to soft freeze.
josh_eng: If we include tenant routing and SSO, infra work is ~3 sprint points and will add ~2 weeks. We can ship without tenant routing and enable as v1.
sam_cs: Customer (Acme) signed up for pilot only if SSO is in. They can accept v1 in 6 weeks but pilot window is fixed. Is there a contingency?
nina_design: UX for SSO is small but needs QA and a small copy pass. I can prioritize if engineering gives a slot.
maria_pm: Proposal: MVP = hosted API + basic auth + embeddings cache; hold tenant SSO and advanced audit for v1. For Acme pilot, offer early-access beta where CS manages manual provisioning + feature flag. Thoughts?
josh_eng: How risky is manual provisioning? Ops can do a temporary workaround but it's not scalable. Also need rollback plan if pilot causes load.
alan_bot: deploybot: canary window for feature flags set to 48h; default ramp 10% -> 100%.
sam_cs: We can run manual provisioning for 2 customers for the pilot. That buys 3 weeks. Acme PM says they'd accept that.
josh_eng: Okay. Then engineering will scope SSO as v1; for MVP we'll ship auth improvements + embedding cache. Need to freeze code by 2026-04-10. That keeps timeline.
maria_pm: I'll update roadmap: move 'tenant routing + SSO + audit logs' to v1 milestone. Update launch criteria document and notify sales. Action items: maria to update roadmap, josh to create SSO epic, nina to prioritize copy, sam to confirm with Acme. Anyone object?
nina_design: :thumbsup: will slot the copy in next sprint.
sam_cs: Confirming with Acme now. Will ping when they sign off on manual provisioning.
josh_eng: Assigning SSO epic to eng-sprint-12, initial spike next week. If we find blockers, will surface.
maria_pm: Thanks all — closing cutboard consensus. I'll post updated milestone in #product later.
